summary: Add backtests of automations (#1389): pkg/automation/backtest runs a saved version of a graph over a dataset of events in capture mode in the background (Svc.Serve, run by modules/automations with the engine) and reports precision and recall per classifier and outcome, the mismatches with labels, the effects the graph would have made, the cost of decisions and a comparison of two backtests. Datasets (≤ 20 per automation, ≤ 5000 events) are copies of events from the outbox journal, from a connection's history (backtest.HistoryImporter, implemented by the email connector's IMAP mailbox, read-only) or a module's HistorySource (automations.WithHistorySources), or synthetic events with expected outcomes; a person's label wins over the expected one; the subject's state is kept as of the event (backtest.SnapshotLoader) or marked approximate. Decisions are cached (an agent's backtest reads the cache only) or live (a person's, with its cost estimated first). New tables automation.datasets, dataset_examples, dataset_labels, dataset_imports, backtests and backtest_results; engine.DryRunInput gets Vars and Now, engine.KeepDeclared, Runtime.Subjects and Runtime.Catalog are exported; the automations screen gets the section «Backtests» at /automations/{id}/backtests (Automations.Author) with its RPC methods and the editor links to it; mcpops.WithBacktests adds the MCP tools of backtests and automations.Backtests gives the composed service.
